hints.title: Adjacent Difference Splitting
hints.text: Split word into independent valid substrings at every index where abs(word[i] - word[i - 1]) > 2.

hints.title: Fixed Window Lengths
hints.text: In any valid substring with c unique characters, each character appears exactly k times, so the window length must be c * k.

hints.title: Sliding Window over Components
hints.text: For each component and each c from 1 to 26 such that c * k <= length, slide a window of size c * k and check if every present character has frequency k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing 26 fixed window sizes over valid adjacent difference components.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) substrings takes O(26 * n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that window length is restricted to multiples c * k for c in 1..26.
